nodes.label: Single-Request Data Enrichment Pattern
nodes.rationale: Enriched endpoints perform multiple JOIN operations to return agent, customer, application, template, device, and location data in one response, reducing round-trips. Trade-off: heavier queries; recommendation is to use regular endpoints when full enrichment is not needed and to add pagination and caching for large datasets.

nodes.label: S3 Presigned URL
nodes.rationale: file_url and thumb_url are presigned S3 URLs expiring after 1 hour; clients must refetch if expired. Recommended over the download endpoint for direct access.

nodes.label: SMS on Ticket Comments
nodes.rationale: When an app user posts a non-internal comment, the backend sends the comment as SMS to the ticket customer via Twilio. Falls back to reporter mobile if customer has none. Internal comments (type=internal) are excluded. Configured via SMS_GATEWAY_ACCESS_SID, SMS_GATEWAY_ACCESS_TOKEN, and SMS_FROM_NUMBER or SMS_MESSAGING_SERVICE_SID.

nodes.label: Sequelize Public Class Field Shadowing Issue
nodes.rationale: Sequelize models using `public` TypeScript class field declarations shadow Sequelize's automatically generated getters and setters. Fix: replace `public id!: number` with `declare id: number`. Applied to all 32 model files. `declare` informs TypeScript without creating a real property, preserving Sequelize's attribute management while maintaining type safety.

nodes.label: Mock Dashboard SVG
nodes.description: SVG UI mockup of the TBT dashboard interface (568x788). Has a dark navy top bar with macOS-style window traffic-light controls (red/yellow/green circles). The body contains an embedded base64-encoded PNG of the full dashboard screen, depicting a ticket-management analytics view with sidebar navigation, metric tiles, charts and a data table. Used as a visual product preview.

nodes.label: Landing Page Hero SVG
nodes.description: Large hero illustration SVG (1528x916) for the TBT landing page. Shows a rounded-corner app window with a drop-shadow effect encasing an embedded screenshot of the TBT application UI. Designed to convey the product at a glance in a marketing context.

nodes.label: User Guide Step 1 – Dark Mode
nodes.description: User guide step 1 in dark mode. Shows a mobile SMS conversation UI with phone number +1 (626) 263-4999. The user has sent 'My laptop screen keeps flickering since the update.' and is typing 'Can you help me with'. Demonstrates the initial step: a user contacts support by sending a plain text/SMS message.

nodes.label: User Guide Step 1 – Light Mode
nodes.description: User guide step 1 in light mode. Identical workflow to the dark variant: user sends an SMS support request ('My laptop screen keeps flickering since the update.') to the TBT SMS number. Light/white color theme.

nodes.label: User Guide Step 2 – Dark Mode
nodes.description: User guide step 2 in dark mode. Shows the automated SMS response: 'Your ticket #TKT-1042 has been created and assigned to an agent. Ticket ID: #TKT-1042, Agent: Alex M. Assigned.' Demonstrates automatic ticket creation and agent assignment confirmation sent back to the user via SMS.

nodes.label: User Guide Step 2 – Light Mode
nodes.description: User guide step 2 in light mode. Same ticket creation confirmation as dark variant: automated response shows '#TKT-1042 has been created and assigned to Agent: Alex M.' Light/white color theme.

nodes.label: User Guide Step 3 – Dark Mode
nodes.description: User guide step 3 in dark mode. Shows two messages: a status update 'Ticket status changed → In Progress' (2 min ago) and the agent message 'Hi! I've reviewed your ticket. Can you tell me which OS version you're on?' Demonstrates the agent taking ownership and communicating via SMS.

nodes.label: User Guide Step 3 – Light Mode
nodes.description: User guide step 3 in light mode. Shows the same agent follow-up flow: ticket status change notification and agent question about OS version. Light/white color theme.

nodes.label: User Guide Step 4 – Dark Mode
nodes.description: User guide step 4 in dark mode. Shows the user replying '@TKT-1042 I'm on macOS 14.3. The flickering happens every 5 min.' with input field pre-filled '@TKT-1042 The issue is still happening…'. Demonstrates how users reference a ticket ID in follow-up messages to route responses back to the correct ticket thread.

nodes.label: User Guide Step 4 – Light Mode
nodes.description: User guide step 4 in light mode. Same ticket-mention follow-up workflow as dark variant: user replies with '@TKT-1042' prefix to route message to the existing ticket. Light/white color theme.

nodes.label: TBT Logo – Dark Variant
nodes.description: TBT brand logo in dark navy/blue color. Shows a speech-bubble icon followed by the acronym 'TBT' in bold and the tagline 'TEXT BASED TICKETING' in smaller text. Intended for use on light/white backgrounds.

nodes.label: TBT Logo – Light Variant
nodes.description: TBT brand logo in white/light color. Same speech-bubble icon and 'TBT / TEXT BASED TICKETING' wordmark as the dark variant. Intended for use on dark/navy backgrounds.

nodes.label: User Avatar Photo
nodes.description: Photographic headshot of a young man with curly dark hair, round glasses, and a beard against a solid purple background. Used as a realistic profile/avatar placeholder for a user or support agent in the UI.

nodes.label: Generic User Profile Icon
nodes.description: Generic user profile icon: a teal/dark-blue filled circle containing a white silhouette of a person (circular head above shoulders). Used as the default/fallback avatar for users without a profile photo.

nodes.label: TBT QR Code
nodes.description: Standard black-and-white QR code. Likely encodes the TBT SMS support number (+1 626 263-4999 as shown in user guide steps) or the TBT service URL, allowing users to quickly initiate contact by scanning the code with a mobile device.
